baseline_binding.note: Baseline is the previous accepted optimized build. Its recorded source manifest differs only in this snapshot-copy change. Original source identities and artifacts are retained; source digests are not repinned.

diagnostic_profiles.interpretation: Diagnostic cProfile data only; collection sums eight worker profiles. Cumulative times overlap. Excluded from throughput medians.
diagnostic_profiles.remaining_bottleneck: Public-observation conversion/validation and serialization dominate collection. Collection remains about two-thirds of process time, and packed rollout payloads are unchanged.

snapshot_copy.scope: Pre-implementation prototype: three timings of 100 full snapshots per arm for each of five characters; median shown. Exact dictionaries and canonical JSON matched. Frozen probe.py patches the original asdict call sites and requires the retained baseline sources, not the new call sites.

update_threads.scope: One update-only pass per thread count on the same validated 4,096-decision batch and fresh model/optimizer owners. Different weights do not demonstrate worse or better learning. Not an end-to-end speed claim; no default changed.

implementation_choices: Reuse bounded dataclass field-name metadata only; no captured game state or snapshot result is cached.
Exact immutable scalars bypass deepcopy; mutable data is independently copied for each capture. Container subclasses, namedtuples and unknown custom leaves retain existing traversal/copy behavior.
Both combat and run snapshots share the internal copier. Snapshot schema versions, validation, RNG capture/restore and adapter stale-action checks remain unchanged.

Engine source changes legitimately change both build and rules digests. Original source bindings remain in all reports; parity excludes these metadata fields only and canonical reload validates each original binding.
Architecture, policy actions/masks, rewards, sampling, GAE, optimizer mathematics, worker scheduling, recording and checkpoints are unchanged. One Torch thread per process remains the default.
limitations: Baseline reuses the previous accepted three timings, with matching script/inputs/runtime/host and only this source delta. It was not rerun in this pass.
Single host and seed schedule; three repetitions per build. OS caches and background load uncontrolled; timing ranges slightly overlap, so the 2.2% median reduction is modest.
Profiler timings include instrumentation and overlapping cumulative work across eight workers; excluded from throughput medians.
50k estimate is linear extrapolation excluding evaluation and export, not another 50k learning experiment.
Parent peak RSS excludes worker processes; no claim of total-pool memory reduction.
Inference bundle format is unchanged. Exact optimizer/RNG resume still requires the matching source build and runtime.

phase_timings.note: Implementation time was not separately measured. Concurrent validation/review intervals must not be summed as task elapsed time.

limitations: Fresh parent per replica; persistent workers within invocation.
OS caches and background load uncontrolled.
protocol.purpose: Throughput only. Same frozen initializer/config/seeds; no strength selection.

scope: Headless CPU throughput only. Same one-learner workload, no playing-strength selection or checkpoint promotion.

independent_semantic_review.scope: Mutation isolation, asdict traversal and deepcopy compatibility, bounded schema-only cache, snapshot schemas/validation, RNG capture/restore, adapter stale-state guard and dependency layering.

validation.note: The two final regression gates ran concurrently and finished before timed benchmarks. Reviewer checks overlap the author gate; do not add them to the 541 final regression count.
